note: Hand-curated catalog of AMD actions. Source: validator typed methods (workflows/appointment-validator/src/amd_client/), AMD knowledge tree (knowledge/reference/amd_api/), and legacy amd-mcp-server tools. Each entry produces one JSON Schema at schemas/generated/<domain>/<action>.json via schema_gen.py. 2026-06-04: expanded per AMD_TOOLS_FULL_BUILDOUT_PLAN-final.txt MERGED-E0.2; +62 entries across patients/visits/providers/codes/billing/masterfiles/system/ehr/meta. 12 meta-domain entries are suppressed from list_tools (DUO-1: tool_name omitted from policy, handled by _factory filter).

actions.name: getdemographic
actions.doc: Fetch one patient's demographic snapshot by patient_id or chart_number. Returns a single patient object: patient_id, insurance_plans (carrier code, carrier name, plan code, plan name, member id, group, effective dates), referral_plans (referring provider id and name, authorization number), chart_files (id, name, type, category, date_of_service), financial_class_code, ins_order. PHI redaction default ON; payer codes and ids are non-PHI; names and member ids are redacted unless elevation is in scope.

patient_id.description: AMD patient_id (numeric string). Provide this OR chart_number.

chart_number.description: Chart number; alternate lookup key. Provide this OR patient_id.

actions.name: getupdatedpatients
actions.doc: List patients whose record changed at or after an ISO 8601 since timestamp (delta-sync feed). Returns since, limit, count, and a patients list. patients rows: patient_id, chart_number, lastupdated. Narrow tracker for nightly-sync workflows; call getdemographic per id to hydrate the full record.

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp; AMD returns patients modified at or after.

actions.name: lookup-patient
actions.doc: Search patients by name fragment or chart number; the primary way to resolve a name to a patient_id. Returns top-level query, page, count, matches, and narrow_query (true when AMD held back results because the search is too broad). Each row in matches carries patient_id, chart_number, first_name, last_name, and dob. Matches are capped at 5 to discourage enumeration. Pass only a query fragment, no PHI body.

query.description: Name fragment or chart number to search.

page.description: Optional 1-based page index for paged enumeration (AARON-REVIEWABLE-2 / DUO-11 default: extend in-place rather than ship a second tool).

actions.name: is-patient
actions.doc: Boolean probe: does this string match at least one AMD patient name? Same lookuppatient wire action as lookup_patient, but match rows are dropped in the handler. Returns is_patient, count, exactmatch, mode, matched_as (last|first|null). No query echo, no ids, no names, no DOB. Use for PHI-free name detection; use lookup_patient to resolve a patient.

name.description: The string to test as a patient name. Punctuation is stripped and it is upper-cased before the search.

exactmatch.description: Exact last-name match (default). False allows AMD prefix matching.

mode.description: last: test as a last name (one AMD call). both: on no last-name hit, also test as a first name via the raw ',NAME' query (second call; unverified live).

actions.name: getmaster-patient
actions.doc: Fetch one patient's master backend record by patient_id or chart_number. Returns top-level patient_id and found (boolean). The verbose AMD master payload is not surfaced in current handler output; this tool is a presence probe, not a full demographic extractor.

actions.name: getpatientvisits
actions.doc: List all visits for one specific patient (history). Returns patient_id, count, by_provider, by_facility, by_apptstatus, and by_year. The per-row fields (visit_id, starttime, duration, apptstatus, provider_id, provider_name, facility_id, facility_name, profile, reason, patient_name, chart_number) feed the summaries; the surfaced response is the aggregated envelope, not the raw rows.

actions.name: getreminderappts
actions.doc: List appointment-reminder rows for a date range (optionally one patient_id). Returns start_date, end_date, count, by_remindertype, by_provider, by_provider_id, and an appts list. appts rows: appointment_id, appointment_datetime, remindertype, provider_id, provider_name, patient_id, patient_name, phone_cell. remindertype and appointment_datetime give the visit type and start time even when the schedule-grid sibling reports them blank.

actions.name: savedemographic
actions.doc: WRITE STUB: would update patient demographics. Hidden by WRITE_TOOLS_ENABLED=False.

actions.name: upddemographic
actions.doc: WRITE STUB: alternate update path for patient demographics.

actions.name: getdatevisits
actions.doc: List office visits scheduled on one specific date for this practice. Returns date, count, by_provider, by_provider_id, by_profile, by_facility, by_facility_id, by_apptstatus, and a visits list. visits rows: visit_id, starttime, duration, apptstatus, provider_id, provider_name, facility_id, facility_name, profile, profile_id, reason, patient_id, patient_name, chart_number. Several text fields (reason, profile, starttime, patient_name, chart_number) may be blank on this office key; empties are real.

actions.name: getupdatedvisits
actions.doc: List visits whose record changed at or after an ISO 8601 since timestamp (delta-sync feed, newest first). Returns since, limit, count, by_provider, by_provider_id, by_facility, by_facility_id, by_apptstatus, and a visits list. visits rows: visit_id, starttime, lastupdated, duration, apptstatus, provider_id, provider_name, facility_id, facility_name, profile, profile_id, reason, patient_id, patient_name, chart_number. lastupdated is the AMD modification timestamp.

actions.name: getreminderrecallvisits
actions.doc: List recall appointments (follow-up reminders due) for a date range. Returns start_date, end_date, max_recalls, count, by_remindertype, by_provider, by_provider_id, and a recalls list. recalls rows: recall_id, recall_date, remindertype, provider_id, provider_name, patient_id, patient_name, chart_number. remindertype labels the recall reason (annual skin check, biopsy follow-up, etc.) as configured in AMD.

start_date.description: Recalls on or after this date.

end_date.description: Recalls on or before this date.

actions.name: addvisit
actions.doc: WRITE STUB: would add a visit for a patient with a given provider profile. Hidden by WRITE_TOOLS_ENABLED=False.

date.description: Visit date; empty string defaults to today.

refplan_id.description: Optional referral plan ID to link.

actions.name: lookup-provider
actions.doc: Search providers via the generic AMD lookup endpoint (class=provider). Sibling: lookupprovider has the same purpose with slightly different paging semantics. Prefer this for plain name search; prefer lookupprovider when you need explicit exact-match or paged enumeration.

actions.name: getupdatedproviders
actions.doc: List in-practice providers added, modified, or deleted since an ISO 8601 since timestamp (delta-sync feed). Returns since, include_profiles, count, by_updatestatus, by_specialty, and a providers list. providers rows: provider_id, name, code, npi, specialty, updatestatus, changedat, createdat. Off-peak Tier 1.

since.description: Saved servertime from previous response (datechanged); ISO 8601.

include_profiles.description: If true, include each provider's profilelist.

actions.name: getupdatedreferringproviders
actions.doc: List referring providers (external doctors who refer into this practice) added or modified since an ISO 8601 since timestamp. Empty since returns the full referring-provider roster (bootstrap pull). Returns since, full_pull, count, by_specialty, and a refproviders list. refproviders rows: refprovider_id, name, code, specialty, practicename. Off-peak Tier 1.

since.description: Saved servertime; if empty, AMD returns all referring providers. Omit or pass empty string for bootstrap full-pull.

actions.name: lookupprovider
actions.doc: Resolve a provider's name (full or fragment) to a provider_id and specialty. Returns name, exact_match, page, count, by_specialty, and a providers list. providers rows: provider_id, name, code, npi, specialty. Set exact_match true to require a literal match; pass page to paginate long rosters. Pass the resolved provider_id to downstream tools rather than guessing.

name.description: Name fragment to search. Empty allowed for paged enumeration.

actions.name: lookup-cpt
actions.doc: Search CPT procedure codes by code number or description fragment (e.g. "99213" or "office visit"). Returns count + matches list sorted by code. Use whenever the user asks for a CPT code; pass codes only — no patient names. Codes are public reference data, NOT PHI.

actions.name: lookup-icd10
actions.doc: Search ICD-10 diagnosis codes by code (e.g. "L82.1") or description fragment (e.g. "actinic keratosis"). Returns count + matches list sorted by code. Looking up an unimported valid ICD-10 code auto-imports it into the office key. Codes are public reference data, NOT PHI.

actions.name: lookup-hcpcs
actions.doc: Search HCPCS supply/injection codes (e.g. "J3301" for triamcinolone) by code or description fragment. Returns count + matches list. Use for billable supplies and injectable medications. Codes are public reference data, NOT PHI.

actions.name: lookup-modcode
actions.doc: Search billing modifier codes (e.g. "25" for significant E/M, "LT" for left side) by code or description fragment. Returns count + matches list. Use when a CPT charge needs a modifier appended. Codes are public reference data, NOT PHI.

actions.name: getchargedetaildata
actions.doc: Fetch the detail envelope for ONE specific charge_id (visit context + status flags). Use when a charge needs to be inspected for void/billed/paymentplan status. Financial amounts (fee, paid, balances) are REDACTED — they do not appear in this tool's output. For a patient's full financial history use gettxhistory.

actions.name: savecharges
actions.doc: WRITE STUB: would save a chargelist against a visit (voids existing charges on the visit per AMD semantics). Hidden by WRITE_TOOLS_ENABLED=False.

chargelist.description: Charges to save; opaque structural placeholder for the stub.

actions.name: updvisitwithnewcharges
actions.doc: WRITE STUB: would post a new chargelist onto an existing visit. Hidden by WRITE_TOOLS_ENABLED=False.

chargelist.description: Charges to post; opaque structural placeholder for the stub.

actions.name: gettxhistory
actions.doc: List one patient's transaction history (charges + payments + write-offs) with by_provcode + by_void + by_paymentplan summaries. Use for "is this patient on a payment plan?" or "are any charges voided?". Raw dollar amounts are REDACTED — status flags and last-payment dates remain visible. No `sum_amount` is returned (aggregating redacted markers is meaningless).

page.description: 1-based page index; AMD returns pagecount in response.

sortbypayment.description: 0=by service type; -1=by payment type (charges omitted from result).

profile_id.description: Optional provider profile filter; empty = all.

actions.name: addpayments
actions.doc: WRITE STUB: would post a payment for a patient (apply against chargelist or place on unappliedpaymentlist). Hidden by WRITE_TOOLS_ENABLED=False.

checknumber.description: Optional check number (PHI; redacted on read).

carrierid.description: Optional carrier ID for insurance payments.

date.description: Payment date; empty defaults to today.

batch.description: Optional batch ID if practice uses batching.

actions.name: getcustomdata
actions.doc: Fetch one patient's custom-tab data (practice-defined custom fields keyed by tab and section). Returns patient_id and found (boolean). Custom field set varies by practice and is not enumerable here; PHI redaction default ON (value, valuecode, valuename redacted).

actions.name: getreminderpatientbirthdays
actions.doc: List patients with birthdays in a date range (monthly birthday-card reminders). Returns start_date, end_date, and count only. Optional min_age and max_age scope the campaign. PHI (names, dob) redacted by default; the row-level birthday list is not surfaced.

actions.name: lookuprespparty
actions.doc: Search responsible-party (guarantor) records by name fragment. Returns query, count, matches, and narrow_query. matches rows: respparty_id, first_name, last_name, name. Matches capped at 5. PHI redaction default ON for guarantor names.

actions.name: addpatient
actions.doc: WRITE STUB: would create a new patient record with respparty + insplan + carrier links. Hidden by WRITE_TOOLS_ENABLED=False.

actions.name: updatepatient
actions.doc: WRITE STUB: would update an existing patient record (force=1 supported). Hidden by WRITE_TOOLS_ENABLED=False.

actions.name: addinsurance
actions.doc: WRITE STUB: would add an insurance plan to a patient's chart. Hidden by WRITE_TOOLS_ENABLED=False.

actions.name: updateinsurance
actions.doc: WRITE STUB: would update an existing insurance plan for a patient (sequence-aware). Hidden by WRITE_TOOLS_ENABLED=False.

actions.name: savepatientnotes
actions.doc: WRITE STUB: would save free-text patient notes (clinic remarks, billing notes). Hidden by WRITE_TOOLS_ENABLED=False.

actions.name: addrespparty
actions.doc: WRITE STUB: would add a responsible-party (guarantor) record linked to a patient. Hidden by WRITE_TOOLS_ENABLED=False.

actions.name: addreferral
actions.doc: WRITE STUB (DUO-3: lives in patients): would add a referral plan for a patient (refprov, reason, proccode, dates). Hidden by WRITE_TOOLS_ENABLED=False.

actions.name: updatereferral
actions.doc: WRITE STUB (DUO-3: lives in patients): would update an existing referral plan on a patient's chart. Hidden by WRITE_TOOLS_ENABLED=False.

actions.name: uploadfile
actions.doc: WRITE STUB (AARON-REVIEWABLE-1 default: lives in patients): would upload a file (base64 contents) to a patient's chart. Streaming flagged (requires_streaming=true); handler enforces 1024kb cap. Hidden by WRITE_TOOLS_ENABLED=False.

file_contents_b64.description: Base64-encoded file body. Hard cap 1024kb at handler level.

local_file_size_hint_kb.description: Optional size hint in kb for pre-flight cap check.

actions.name: getupdatedpatientstemplate
actions.doc: META HELPER (DUO-1: tool_name=null, suppressed from list_tools): returns the static schema metadata for getupdatedpatients. Used by schema_gen and tests, never invoked by Adam.

actions.name: getfieldsets
actions.doc: META HELPER (DUO-1: tool_name=null, suppressed from list_tools): returns the AMD field-set metadata. Used by tests and tooling, never invoked by Adam.

actions.name: getupdatedvisitstemplate
actions.doc: META HELPER (DUO-1: tool_name=null, suppressed): returns getupdatedvisits schema template.

actions.name: lookupprofile
actions.doc: Search provider profile records (provider, facility, financial-class combinations) by query string. Returns query, count, matches, and narrow_query (true when results were held back because the query is too broad). matches rows: profile_id, name, code. Matches capped at 5. profile_id is what charge entry and visit creation expect.

actions.name: lookuprefprovider
actions.doc: Search referring-provider records by name fragment. Returns query, count, matches, and narrow_query. matches rows: refprovider_id, name, code, specialty, practicename. Matches capped at 5. refprovider_id is the value addreferral and updatereferral expect.

actions.name: getupdatedproviderstemplate
actions.doc: META HELPER (DUO-1: tool_name=null, suppressed): returns getupdatedproviders schema template.

actions.name: lookupproccode
actions.doc: Search procedure (CPT) codes via class=api with optional subtype filter. Sibling to lookup-cpt; docx class differs (api vs cpt). Public reference data, NOT PHI.

subtype.description: Optional subtype filter from docx (e.g. surgical, e/m).

actions.name: lookupdiagcode
actions.doc: Search diagnosis (ICD-10) codes via class=api with optional subtype filter. Sibling to lookup-icd10. Public reference data.

actions.name: lookupmodcode
actions.doc: Search modifier codes via class=api with optional subtype filter. Sibling to lookup-modcode (class=modcode). Public reference data.

actions.name: newbatch
actions.doc: WRITE STUB: would create a new billing batch (header for grouping charges/payments). Hidden by WRITE_TOOLS_ENABLED=False.

actions.name: lookupcarrier
actions.doc: Search insurance carriers in the practice master file by query. Returns count + matches with carrier_id, carrier_code, carrier_name. Public master data.

actions.name: lookupfinclass
actions.doc: Search financial-class master records by query. Returns count + matches with finclass_id, finclass_code, name. Master data, not PHI.

actions.name: lookupaccttype
actions.doc: Search account-type master records by query. Returns count + matches. Master data, not PHI.

actions.name: lookupzipcode
actions.doc: Search the master zipcode table by code prefix or city. Returns count + matches with zip, city, state. Public reference data.

actions.name: lookupnotetypes
actions.doc: Search note-type master records by query. Returns count + matches with notetype_id, label. Master data, not PHI.

actions.name: selectfacilities
actions.doc: List all facility master records. Returns count + facilities with id, code, name, address. Master data, not PHI.

actions.name: selectdiagnosiscodes
actions.doc: List the practice's imported diagnosis codes (subset of full ICD-10). Returns count + codes. Public reference data.

actions.name: selectuserfiletemplates
actions.doc: List the practice's user-defined file templates, optionally scoped to a template type. Returns count + templates. Master data, not PHI.

actions.name: savenotetypes
actions.doc: WRITE STUB: would save practice-defined note types. Hidden by WRITE_TOOLS_ENABLED=False.

actions.name: getsysdefaults
actions.doc: Fetch system defaults: large nested categories payload (places of service, ROS categories, billing options, etc). CAV per DUO-15: payload may be >10MB. Caller should cache and paginate at request level. Off-peak Tier 1.

category_filter.description: Optional comma-separated category whitelist to reduce payload.

actions.name: getehrallergies
actions.doc: BETA EHR: List a patient's allergies with status, reaction, treatment, drug-allergy category. PHI redacted by default (allergy, reaction, treatment).

actions.name: getehrhwplans
actions.doc: BETA EHR: List a patient's health-and-wellness plans. PHI redacted by default.

actions.name: getehrimmunizations
actions.doc: BETA EHR: List a patient's immunizations with dates and types. PHI redacted by default.

actions.name: getehrmedications
actions.doc: BETA EHR: List a patient's medications with dosage, frequency, prescriber. PHI redacted by default.

actions.name: getehrprofiles
actions.doc: BETA EHR: List EHR provider-profile records used by EHR notes and orders.

actions.name: getehrproblems
actions.doc: BETA EHR: List a patient's active problem list with ICD-10 codes and statuses. PHI redacted by default.

actions.name: getehrtemplates
actions.doc: BETA EHR: List the practice's EHR note templates. Public master data.

actions.name: getehrlabresults
actions.doc: BETA EHR (CAV per DUO-17): list a patient's lab results. resultvalue is clinical PHI; strict_mode_patterns required.

actions.name: getehrnotes
actions.doc: BETA EHR (CAV per DUO-17): list a patient's EHR notes. Heavy free-text PHI; redacted by default.

actions.name: getehrnotesbyvisit
actions.doc: BETA EHR (CAV per DUO-17): list EHR notes scoped to one visit. Heavy free-text PHI; redacted by default.

actions.name: getehrupdatednotes
actions.doc: BETA EHR (CAV per DUO-17): delta-sync feed of EHR notes changed since ISO 8601 timestamp. High-volume PHI; off-peak Tier 1.

actions.name: getehrccdadata
actions.doc: BETA EHR (CAV per DUO-17): fetch CCDA structured-data payload for a patient. Strict redact across all named fields.

actions.name: getehrccdadocument
actions.doc: BETA EHR (CAV per DUO-5, DUO-17): fetch the CCDA ClinicalDocument XML blob for a patient. Handler-level body replacement is MANDATORY: when ALLOW_PHI is false, ClinicalDocument string is replaced with '[REDACTED:CCDA]' before return.

actions.name: addehrnote
actions.doc: BETA EHR WRITE STUB: would create an EHR note with polymorphic fields. Hidden by WRITE_TOOLS_ENABLED=False.

actions.name: addehrnotebyvisit
actions.doc: BETA EHR WRITE STUB: would create an EHR note scoped to a visit. Hidden by WRITE_TOOLS_ENABLED=False.

actions.name: updateehrnote
actions.doc: BETA EHR WRITE STUB: would update an existing EHR note. Hidden by WRITE_TOOLS_ENABLED=False.

actions.name: addehrproblem
actions.doc: BETA EHR WRITE STUB: would add a problem to a patient's problem list. Hidden by WRITE_TOOLS_ENABLED=False.

actions.name: updateehrproblem
actions.doc: BETA EHR WRITE STUB: would update a problem record. Hidden by WRITE_TOOLS_ENABLED=False.

actions.name: addehrhwplans
actions.doc: BETA EHR WRITE STUB (docx singular: addehrhwplan): would add a health-and-wellness plan. Hidden by WRITE_TOOLS_ENABLED=False.

actions.name: updateehrhwplans
actions.doc: BETA EHR WRITE STUB: would update an existing HW plan. Hidden by WRITE_TOOLS_ENABLED=False.

actions.name: saveehrccdadata
actions.doc: BETA EHR WRITE STUB: would save CCDA structured data. Hidden by WRITE_TOOLS_ENABLED=False.

ccda_payload.description: Structured CCDA data; opaque structural placeholder for the stub.

actions.name: saveehrccdadocument
actions.doc: BETA EHR WRITE STUB: would save a CCDA ClinicalDocument XML blob. Handler does not parse; opaque body. Hidden by WRITE_TOOLS_ENABLED=False.

actions.name: getehrhwplanstemplate
actions.doc: META HELPER (DUO-1: tool_name=null, suppressed): returns getehrhwplans schema template.

actions.name: getehrimmunizationstemplate
actions.doc: META HELPER (DUO-1: tool_name=null, suppressed): returns getehrimmunizations schema template.

actions.name: getehrlabresultstemplate
actions.doc: META HELPER (DUO-1: tool_name=null, suppressed): returns getehrlabresults schema template.

actions.name: getehrmedicationstemplate
actions.doc: META HELPER (DUO-1: tool_name=null, suppressed): returns getehrmedications schema template.

actions.name: getehrnotestemplate
actions.doc: META HELPER (DUO-1: tool_name=null, suppressed): returns getehrnotes schema template.

actions.name: getehrproblemstemplate
actions.doc: META HELPER (DUO-1: tool_name=null, suppressed): returns getehrproblems schema template.

actions.name: getehrtemplatestemplate
actions.doc: META HELPER (DUO-1: tool_name=null, suppressed): returns getehrs schema template.

actions.name: getehrallergiestemplate
actions.doc: META HELPER (DUO-1: tool_name=null, suppressed): returns getehrallergies schema template.
